faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for DMFT Dhanbad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 21 November 2026. Applications opened on 30 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in DMFT Dhanbad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 74 vacancies: 48 Medical Officer (NRHM + NUHM), 13 General Physician (NRHM + NCD Cell), 2 Gynecologist (NRHM + NUHM), 7 Paediatrician (NRHM + NUHM), 4 Anesthesiologist (NRHM + NUHM).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for DMFT Dhanbad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 21 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: 63,000/Month for Medical Officer (NRHM + NUHM), 1,10,000/Month for General Physician (NRHM + NCD Cell), 1,10,000/Month for Gynecologist (NRHM + NUHM), 1,10,000/Month for Paediatrician (NRHM + NUHM), 1,10,000/Month for Anesthesiologist (NRHM + NUHM).

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: MBBS / Post Graduate Degree / Diploma in relevant medical specialization. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Selected Specialist Doctors must serve at least 3 Days/Week in the posted Hospital.

faq.question: Q7. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications submitted through offline mode shall not be accepted or considered.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Personnel Interview. Document Verification. Marks obtained in the interview will be the criteria for selection.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Initially for a period of one year from the date of joining. Purely contractual engagement.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Dhanbad.
